program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_a@j | is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j, !is_b@j | is_a@j & !is_b@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(!is_bos@j & is_a@j | is_a@i & !is_b@i, is_a@i & !is_b@i | !is_a@j & is_b@j)
accept = is_a & !is_b & !h1_1 | !is_a & is_b & h1_1 & !h1_2

output accept
